actor_fields.name: gyro
actor_fields.meaning: Body-frame angular velocity from the actor IMU.

actor_fields.name: command_xyz_yaw
actor_fields.meaning: Requested local vx, vy and yaw rate.

actor_fields.name: q_minus_default
actor_fields.meaning: Measured joint angle minus home angle, in joint_order.

actor_fields.name: dq_scaled
actor_fields.meaning: Measured joint angular velocity multiplied by joint_velocity_scale.

actor_fields.name: last_action
actor_fields.meaning: Committed normalized policy action at t-1.

actor_fields.name: last_last_action
actor_fields.meaning: Committed normalized policy action at t-2.

actor_fields.name: last_last_last_action
actor_fields.meaning: Committed normalized policy action at t-3.

actor_fields.name: last_motor_targets
actor_fields.meaning: Previous joint targets after rate and position limits, before actuator delay.

actor_fields.name: contacts_left_right
actor_fields.meaning: Measured left and right foot contacts.

actor_fields.name: phase
actor_fields.meaning: Cosine, sine of the actor gait phase.

actor_fields.name: relative_heading_sin_cos
actor_fields.meaning: Sine and cosine of yaw minus latched heading. Equals [0, 1] while idle or on yaw commands.

critic_extra_fields.name: gravity_body
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Gravity direction in the body frame.

critic_extra_fields.name: clean_q_minus_default
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Clean joint angle minus home angle, in joint_order.

critic_extra_fields.name: clean_dq
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Unscaled joint angular velocity, in joint_order.

critic_extra_fields.name: contacts
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Actual left and right foot contacts.

critic_extra_fields.name: foot_velocities_world
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Two world-frame XYZ velocities, left foot then right.

critic_extra_fields.name: foot_air_times
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Left and right foot time since liftoff.

critic_extra_fields.name: imitation_phase
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Cosine, sine of the unshifted actor phase.

critic_extra_fields.name: cross_track
critic_extra_fields.meaning: Signed lateral world displacement from the latched path.

observations.heading_reference: Latch IMU heading when command axis/sign or stop/move mode changes; hold through speed changes
observations.training_phase: Active steps advance the phase. Start from the sampled phase on motion onset, keep phase through direction changes, and set it to zero while idle.
observations.runtime_phase: Advance on committed active sends. Reset phase on motion start or stop and hold phase at zero while idle.

normalization.when: PPO updates observation statistics. ONNX export embeds actor statistics.
